specifications.prompt: REFERENCE ROLE: attached image defines EXACT game art and camera style. Produce ONLY the clean environment layer for this mobile game, no robots, bosses, gates, projectiles, warnings, UI, logos or text. Vertical 9:16 premium stylized 3D toy-metal environment. Blue-gray brushed steel roadway, large slabs, fine restrained texture, thick yellow safety rails. Three lanes separated by TWO slim ivory lane lines, consistent perspective. Precisely place vanishing point at x50% y24%; road starts narrow at x47%-53% y24%, widens to x0%-100% at bottom. Road occupies middle and lower screen; side buildings stay OUTSIDE the road edges, never block lanes. Horizon skyline y20%. Coherent bright upper-left sunlight, real soft contact lighting, warm orange architectural highlights, blue road shadows, rich atmospheric depth. Match attached reference material, lighting, sense of speed and camera, not a flat cartoon or watercolor. Empty road ready for separately rendered game characters. No black fades or border.
